forum.title: STM32H753IITx + ST67W611M1
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @AA\_NC ,

There is a dedicated wiki page related to the X-CUBE-ST67W61 pack usage in STM32CubeMX you can find [here.](https://wiki.st.com/stm32mcu/wiki/Connectivity:Wi-Fi_How_to_use_X_CUBE_ST67W61_STM32CubeMx_pack)

This should answer your questions, but basically yes you can port on all target having the minimum hardware requirements (section 1.1)

Hoping this will help you !

Regards

Louis
forum.content_text:
Hi,

For STM32H753IITx + ST67W611M1 on a custom board with FreeRTOS:

What is the recommended integration approach for X-CUBE-ST67W61 on STM32H753?

Specifically:

1. Is STM32H753 officially supported/recommended as a host MCU for ST67W611M1?

2. For H753, is it recommended to use the middleware directly from CubeMX?

3. Are there known FreeRTOS version compatibility issues between CubeMX-generated FreeRTOS and X-CUBE-ST67W61 on H753?

Thank you.
